# FLX-5036: profile document refused

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

A profile is read whole or not at all, and this one does not have the shape docs/spec/PROFILE-SPEC.md gives a profile: a key the format does not define, a count that is not a non-negative JSON integer, a number written as a JSON float or in a spelling other than a plain decimal string, a statistic whose definition is not registered, or cells and flags that do not line up. The message names where in the document the problem is. Regenerate the profile with a profiler that writes this format version, or correct the named entry. A profile of format 1-4-0 is also refused for these reasons, each named at the entry that breaks it: the relationships its privacy unit follows are not a tree rooted at the unit's expose, because two followed relationships lead into one table, because the parent of a followed relationship is a table the unit does not reach, or because they form a cycle; an estimated clique release, written as an estimate on a clique or as measurements or published: estimated in a cliqueSelection, because this format reads measured cliques only; and a table whose cliques are too many, hold too many cells together, or ask for more cell visits to sum and compare than the clique work limit allows (40,000,000), which is decided from the structure of the cliques before any count is read. Name fewer cliques, narrower domains or fewer levels, or publish measured cliques.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5036
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
